fact: On 24 February 2026 the Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation invited bids for the supply, delivery and installation of IFMIS servers for the Government of Lesotho under the AfDB-financed e-Government Infrastructure Phase II project.
title: SPN - Lesotho - Supply, Delivery and Installation OF IFMIS Servers for the Government of Lesotho - e-Government Infrastructure Phase II Project
